This document is a technical overview of Project Maya, a system for running large open models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) locally. Key points:

**Quantization & Quality**
- Maya quants retain 97.7–99.2% of FP8 zero-shot accuracy; next-token agreement 83–90% (GLM), 92.6% (DeepSeek), 87.6% (MiniMax).

**Performance**
